data.name: MobileControl_Desc
data.value: Phone input with country picker, validation (libphonenumber-js), country/type rules and click-to-call.

data.name: Phone_Value_Desc
data.value: Phone or text column storing the number.

data.name: NumberValid_Desc
data.value: Optional Yes/No column set to Yes when the number is valid (or empty). Use it in business rules or flows.

data.name: OutputFormat_Desc
data.value: How a valid number is written to the column.

data.name: DefaultCountry_Desc
data.value: ISO 3166 alpha-2 code (e.g. FR) selected for empty fields and used to read national numbers.

data.name: PriorityCountries_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated ISO codes listed at the top of the country picker (e.g. FR,BE,CH).

data.name: AllowedCountries_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated ISO codes. Empty = all countries. Also filters the picker.

data.name: ExcludedCountries_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated ISO codes that are refused and hidden from the picker.

data.name: AllowedTypes_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated: mobile, fixed_line, toll_free, premium_rate, shared_cost, voip, personal_number, pager, uan, voicemail. Empty = all.

data.name: ExcludedTypes_Desc
data.value: Comma-separated number types that are refused (same values as allowed types).

data.name: BlockSave_Desc
data.value: Shows a field notification that prevents saving while the number is invalid.

data.name: ShowFlags_Desc
data.value: Flags are loaded from flagcdn.com. Choose No if that site is blocked: the ISO code is shown instead.

data.name: CallProvider_Desc
data.value: Shows a call button that opens the chosen provider.

data.name: CustomCallProtocol_Desc
data.value: Used when Call button = Custom, e.g. callto or sip.

data.name: OpenQuickCreate_Desc
data.value: When the call button is clicked, also opens the Phone Call quick create form (model-driven apps).

data.name: Err_CountryNotAllowed
data.value: Numbers from this country are not allowed

data.name: Err_TypeNotAllowed
data.value: This type of number is not allowed
